subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as a core agent-default config surface now, with `full` as the only tier that includes hook-loaded extra bootstrap files?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but the choice creates a public config/default contract for prompt context, session behavior, and hook-extra semantics that automation should not approve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor This Shape
options.body: Review and land this PR after confirming no-override defaults, tier names, hook-extra semantics, and public docs are the intended contract.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Context Selection
options.body: Keep the PR open or ask for a replacement that unifies this with related deterministic/bootstrap-context selection issues.

options.title: Decline The Config Knob
options.body: Close the PR and keep users on existing bootstrap budgets, contextInjection, lightweight mode, and hook controls instead of adding another config surface.
